sent.title: Verify your address
sent.description: A verification link has been sent to {email}. Open it to activate your account.
sent.checkSpam: The email sometimes takes a few minutes to arrive. Remember to look in your junk folder.
sent.resendHint: A new link can be requested every 60 seconds. The previous one then stops working.
sent.resent: A new link has just been sent.

verified.title: Address verified
verified.description: The address {email} is confirmed. You can now sign in.

rejected.invalid: This verification link is not valid. Your email software may have broken it: open it from the message rather than copying it out.
rejected.expired: This verification link has expired. Sign in to receive a new one.
rejected.already_used: This address has already been verified. All that is left is to sign in.

empty.title: No link to check
empty.description: This page confirms an address from the link received by email. Open that link from your mailbox.
